## Private development checklist

- [ ] Repository remains private; PR remains Draft and `main` is unchanged.
- [ ] No deployment, publish, release, or inherited Actions enablement.
- [ ] No paid provider, real data, or unapproved remote side effects.
- [ ] User-facing names and links use Bostan; mandatory legal notices survive.
- [ ] Failed, skipped, and unrun gates are disclosed explicitly.
